M-BACKEND-CORE.Summary: Settings from env (.env) and domain errors mapped to JSON HTTP responses.

M-DB.Summary: SQLAlchemy async engine/session, ORM models created_campaigns, offer_changes (push log), streams and stream_offers (editor wrapper with drafts), Alembic migrations 0001-0003.

M-KEITARO-CLIENT.Summary: Async client for Keitaro Admin API v1 (Api-Key header) over one shared keep-alive httpx client opened in the app lifespan: campaigns, streams, offers, domains, groups, traffic sources, report/build. Campaign and offer lists are cached in-process for KEITARO_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS (default 60, invalidated on campaign create/delete); stream reads and reports are never cached.

M-CAMPAIGN-CREATOR.Summary: Creates a position campaign with domain/group/source, a forced geo stream (country accept filter, redirect to Google) and a regular landings stream with the offer at 100%; rolls back the campaign if stream creation fails; stores history.

M-OFFER-EDITOR.Summary: Draft/publish editor over a local wrapper of Keitaro streams: Fetch Streams sync, draft add / remove (grey, share 0) / bring back / pin / unpin with pinned-aware equal split, Push (only active offers to Keitaro, at least one active, active sum must be 100, 409 if Keitaro changed since the last fetch/push) and Cancel (restore last published snapshot); push audit log; per-offer stats.

M-BACKEND-API.Summary: FastAPI app and HTTP routes under /api plus request/response DTOs; the source of the API contract.

M-API-CONTRACT.Summary: Committed OpenAPI contract exported from M-BACKEND-API, its export script, and the generated frontend TypeScript types. Any change here requires a GRACE change bundle.

M-FRONTEND-SHARED.Summary: FSD shared layer: typed API client (openapi-fetch), shadcn/ui primitives, formatting, share arithmetic mirror, URL state, country list.

M-FRONTEND-ENTITIES.Summary: FSD entities: campaign (queries, state badge), offer (queries, stats cells), reference (domains/groups/sources/defaults), stream (meta).

M-FRONTEND-FEATURES.Summary: FSD features: create-campaign, select-campaign, select-interval, fetch-streams, add-offer, remove-offer, restore-offer, pin-offer, publish-stream.

M-FRONTEND-WIDGETS.Summary: FSD widgets: stream-offers card (yellow draft state with Push/Cancel, pins, removed offers with bring back), offer-changes-log (push log), created-campaigns table, app-header.

M-FRONTEND-APP.Summary: FSD app layer and frontend tooling: root component, react-router-dom routes (/ creator, /editor, /campaigns/:campaignId, legacy ?page= redirect), query provider, global styles, entrypoint, Vite/TS/steiger/shadcn config, Dockerfile and nginx (SPA fallback to index.html).

M-INFRA.Summary: docker-compose stack, root Makefile with run targets and verification gates, backend Dockerfile and project packaging, README.

DF-CREATE-CAMPAIGN.Summary: Creator form -> POST /api/campaigns -> Keitaro POST /campaigns, POST /streams (geo), POST /streams (offer) -> created_campaigns row -> URL shown in UI.

DF-EDIT-OFFERS.Summary: Editor -> GET /api/campaigns/{id}/editor (wrapper streams, auto Fetch Streams on first open, report/build stats) -> draft actions edit streams/stream_offers only -> Push -> Keitaro PUT /streams/{id} -> wrapper re-synced + offer_changes row; Cancel restores the published snapshot; Fetch Streams marks offers deleted in Keitaro as removed.
